exposure: Intra-abdominal varicose vein of the fetal umbilical vein
cohort: A single fetus diagnosed with an intra-abdominal varicose vein of the fetal umbilical vein.
finding: The perinatal prognosis for intra-abdominal varicose vein of the fetal umbilical vein is favorable when it is identified as an isolated finding, but variable when associated with other anomalies.
